outcome.stat_test: Combined 5x2cv F-test (Alpaydin) at 95% per dataset (bold = C4.5+LS significantly better than that method; italic = method significantly better than C4.5+LS); Friedman test with Holm procedure (Demsar) on ranks at 95% (✓ = C4.5+LS significantly lower rank)

win_claim.quote: This framework is able to achieve significantly better performances than other contemporary methods. As per the Friedman test, it achieves best performance, and statistically so, across 20 datasets derived from different domains.

uncertain: No plain SMOTE baseline; smote fields left null. C4.5+UnSM (undersampling+SMOTE, wrapper-tuned) recorded in extra fields unsm_* (Table 3, p.8); caller may decide whether to treat it as the SMOTE comparator.
Which UCI datasets (Breast-W, Page, Pendigits, Pima, Satimage, Segment) were converted from multiclass (smallest class vs rest) is not stated; how_obtained set to 'not stated' (p.8).
Table 2 gives only MinClass as a percentage (stored in minclass_printed), not counts or IR; n_minority/n_majority/ir_printed null (p.7).
Compustat and Intrusion n_instances printed as train/test pairs; stored null with examples_printed (p.7).
Source for E-State and Mammography only says 'real-world scenarios originally considered in [6]'; repository not named (p.7-8).
Dataset names differ in case between Table 2 and Table 3 (e.g. Breast-W vs Breast-w, FourClass vs Fourclass, SVMGuide1 vs SVMguide1); names as printed in each table kept.
PDF page index assumed equal to page numbering (no printed page numbers visible).
notes: Proposed method: Local Sampling (LS) with C4.5 = Hellinger-distance partitioning (tree height 2, <=4 segments) + per-partition wrapper-tuned undersampling (0-100 step 10) and SMOTE (0-500 step 50). SVM was not combined with UnSM or LS (computational cost, p.7). Table 4 (p.9) lists chosen sampling parameters (Undersample, SMOTE) per dataset for UnSM and LS, and (k, r) for COG-OS. Table 1 (p.4) gives synthetic 2-D radial experiments (9 scenarios, skew 50:1000) for C4.5 vs C4.5+sampling only, not part of the main suite. Pima illustrative example p.6: C4.5 0.765, LS 0.817, global UnSM 0.790. Text p.9 counts significant improvements on 18 tested datasets: 10 vs C4.5+UnSM. Table 3 checked against rendered page image (text extraction matched). best_other chosen as max among the five non-LS columns as printed. Authors offer datasets/code on request; no supplementary file referenced.
